```yaml
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages with Version Bump

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: deploy
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # needed for tags

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Set remote URL with token
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Read current version
        id: read_version
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "_includes/VERSION.txt" ]; then
            echo "Error: _includes/VERSION.txt not found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          current=$(cat _includes/VERSION.txt)
          echo "current=$current" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Increment version
        id: bump_version
        run: |
          new=$((current + 1))
          echo "new=$new" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Write new version
        run: |
          echo -n "${{ steps.bump_version.outputs.new }}" > _includes/VERSION.txt

      - name: Check for duplicate tag
        run: |
          tag="v${{ steps.bump_version.outputs.new }}"
          if git ls-remote --tags origin "$tag" | grep -q "$tag"; then
            echo "Tag $tag already exists. Aborting."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Commit version bump
        run: |
          git add _includes/VERSION.txt
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to ${{ steps.bump_version.outputs.new }}"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create and push tag
        run: |
          tag="v${{ steps.bump_version.outputs.new }}"
          git tag "$tag"
          git push origin "$tag"

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install jekyll bundler
          bundle install

      - name: Build Jekyll site
        run: jekyll build

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./_site
```
